tagline: Walls on all four sides, so a burrowing dog always has something to press into.
lead: Wherever your dog turns, there is a cushioned wall to curl against, with fleece underneath and memory foam below that.
value: Two layers of foam and a fully enclosed surround, sized for a small or medium dog rather than swamping them.
intro: Hazel is a memory foam nest sofa, 76 × 51cm, bolstered on all four sides, with memory foam over an egg-crate layer, a fleece sleeping surface and textured linen-effect side panels.
points: Four cushioned sides, not three with a gap.
Memory foam over an egg-crate support layer, under the fleece.
A soft sleeping surface inside the walls, for curling up tight.
Textured linen-effect side panels, so it sits in the room like furniture rather than pet kit.
best_for: Small and medium dogs who sleep curled tight, like to burrow, or end up wedged in the corner of the sofa.
fit_note: One size. The four-sided bolster takes up a good part of the outside, so measure your dog curled up rather than stretched out. Unsure? Ask us with their breed and weight.
care: Follow the sewn-in care label on the cover. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.
seo_title: Four-Sided Memory Foam Nest Dog Sofa | Snoozly
seo_description: A memory foam nest dog sofa with cushioned walls on all four sides, for burrowers. Fleece inside, linen-effect sides, 76 × 51cm, for small to medium dogs.
